title_zh: 发现新桌面划痕后约定店方查看

scenario.goal_zh: 描述划痕和桌脚情况，同意停止擦拭，并约定发送照片后由店方安排检查

context_zh: 顾客致电家具店说明刚送到的新桌子出现痕迹。
author: author-phase09-a

sentences.speaker: Mabel
sentences.text: There is a scratch across the top of the table that arrived this morning.

sentences.speaker: Anton
sentences.text: I am sorry to hear that. Is there any damage to the legs?

sentences.speaker: Mabel
sentences.text: The legs look fine, and all four rubber feet are in place. It is just the top.

sentences.speaker: Anton
sentences.text: Have you tried to rub the mark with anything?

sentences.speaker: Mabel
sentences.text: Only a dry cloth, very lightly. It did not change.

sentences.speaker: Anton
sentences.text: Please leave it as it is and send us a clear photo. I will arrange for our service team to inspect it.

sentences.speaker: Mabel
sentences.text: All right. I'll stop wiping it and send photos of the mark and the whole table.
